y-m-73-02.title: Meesha ugu hooseysa kharashka cutub kasta ma tahay meesha faa'iidada ugu weyn?
y-m-73-02.topic: Kharashka celceliska iyo wax-soo-saarka faa'iidada ugu weyn
y-m-73-02.goal: Hubi in wax-soo-saarka kharashka celceliska ugu hooseeya cutub kasta iyo wax-soo-saarka faa'iidada ugu weyn ay kala duwanaan karaan, adigoo hagaajinaya xukunkaaga marka macluumaad qiime kasta la bixiyo.
y-m-73-02.material:
Goob lagu sameeyo saabuun gacmeed waxay samaysaa q cutub (tiro dhan) bil kasta oo dhammaan way iibisaa. Wadarta kharashka hal bil waa C(q) = 50 + 10q + q² (cutubka: 천 원). Taas dhexdeeda, 50 waa kharash go'an, kaas oo la bixiyo bil kasta xitaa haddii hal cutub la samayn waayo. Faa'iidada = qiimaha iibka × q − C(q). Kharashka celceliska cutub kasta waa C(q) ÷ q. (q² loo akhriyo 'q labajibaaran'.)

Wax-soo-saarka q (cutub) | Wadarta kharashka (천 원) | Kharashka celceliska cutub kasta (천 원)
1 | 61 | 61.00
3 | 89 | 29.67
5 | 125 | 25.00
7 | 169 | 24.14
8 | 194 | 24.25
10 | 250 | 25.00
15 | 425 | 28.33
20 | 650 | 32.50

(Akhri shaxda sida kala horreynta q, wadarta kharashka, kharashka celceliska. Qiimayaasha tirada dhan ee q dhexdooda, kharashka celceliska ugu hooseeya wuxuu ku jiraa q=7.)
